items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Bud Scott and Johnny and that bunch. This later, I don't know, I can't remember her name, but we were rehearsing and she was singing

ctx.x: Mitchell was saying Jelly Roll used to rehearse quite a bit for his records sometimes. Two or three. Just one rehearsal for that.
Well, sometimes when we recorded with singers, we would rehearse the singers. We rehearse one singer
